config.spacing: per-element mean distance to four nearest other clean vstars, at K=256
config.position_noise: fixed length alpha*h_i, uniform random direction; translate the full quadric congruently
config.normal_noise: fixed-angle rotation about random perpendicular axis; preserve each normal magnitude
config.quadric_noise: principal PSD square root F of full homogeneous 4x4 Q; Fprime=F+alpha*normF*G/normG; Qprime=Fprime@Fprime.T; recompute vstars with frozen P and eps=.05
config.joint_order: quadric factor (2%), then translate vstar and Q (2% h_clean), then rotate normal (2deg)
config.normalization: bbox centered, bbox diagonal 2; original triangle surface used as reference
config.thresholds: No accuracy threshold invented; report topology/geometry and paired perturbation changes

full4 Q noise is not identical to future 3x3 learned-factor errors
